repositories.requirement: Mount only this company's allow-listed repositories into its execution context.

documents.requirement: Resolve documents by opaque reference inside the company boundary; no host-wide reads or search.

memory.requirement: Company-bound memory namespace enforced server-side; no fallback to shared operator memory.

connected_apps.requirement: Company-scoped service accounts; object ownership validated on every call.

browser_sessions.requirement: Dedicated browser process/profile/storage per company; direct human login only.

credentials.requirement: Broker-held secrets; tasks receive scoped actions, never environment bundles or cookies.

outputs.requirement: Artifacts, logs and receipts bound to company/project/task; delivery only to authorized destinations.

network.requirement: Deny by default; only approved endpoints through the protected egress layer.

model_inference.requirement: Every inference lane (primary, auxiliary, delegation, memory) checked against allowed routes before any payload leaves.

cross_company_sharing.requirement: Denied unless a purpose-, source-, destination- and expiry-bound grant names both companies.
